integrity: Universal claims follow from a proof using classical topology and published chessboard connectivity/torsion results; finite check scripts supply reproducible corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only pi1, pi2 and H2 of ordinary geometric quotients are established; no higher homotopy, full cohomology or composite-parameter classification. Source-based priority remains provisional; not independently audited.
title: Prime-order second homotopy in diagonal cyclic quotients of square chessboard complexes
